title: Tenant Hierarchy: Parent Tenants That Create and Open Their Own Sites | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
The CrestApps Tenant Hierarchy lets one Orchard Core tenant create and run its own child tenants, and lets its people open them without signing in again.

Many organizations run a separate site for each customer they serve. With plain multi-tenancy only the platform administrator can create those sites, staff need an account on every one, and nothing ties what they do back to the person who did it. The Tenant Hierarchy makes such an organization a parent: it creates and runs its own child tenants, its people open them without a password, and every tenant stays isolated.

In this video:
• The problem it solves, and how platform, parents and child tenants are organized
• Making a tenant a parent, and its policy
• Adding, opening and managing child tenants
• Access rules, the activity in the audit trail, and the platform's oversight
• How it stays secure, and setting it up in code
